chats.answer:
An HDMI KVM switch lets you control two or more computers using a single monitor, keyboard, and mouse.

For example, if you have a desktop PC and a laptop, you can switch between them with one button without unplugging cables.

What to look for

2-port HDMI KVM: Connect 2 computers to 1 monitor.

4-port HDMI KVM: Connect up to 4 computers.

Dual-monitor HDMI KVM: Share 2 monitors between computers.

4K 60Hz: Good for office work and general use.

4K 120Hz / 144Hz: Better for gaming or high-refresh-rate monitors.

USB 3.0: Useful for sharing webcams, USB drives, and other peripherals.
